title: AlignMerge - Alignment-Preserving Large Language Model Merging via Fisher-Guided Geometric Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2512.16245v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Merging large language models (LLMs) is a practical way to compose capabilities from multiple fine-tuned checkpoints without retraining. Yet standard schemes (linear weight soups, task vectors, and Fisher-weighted averaging) can preserve loss while quietly destroying alignment. We argue that merging is not a numerical trick but a geometry-constrained operation around an already-aligned anchor: fusion must be steered to respect safety geometry, not validated post hoc.   We introduce AlignMerge, a geometry-aware merging framework that makes alignment an explicit invariant. In a local Fisher chart around an instruction-tuned base, we estimate an alignment subspace with projector P_A and optimize:   L_AlignMerge = L_geo + lambda_align * L_align + lambda_bud * L_bud,   where L_geo keeps the merge close to its experts in Fisher-Rao geometry, L_align penalizes motion along alignment-sensitive directions, and L_bud enforces a soft alignment

translated_title: AlignMerge——通过Fisher引导的几何约束实现保持对齐性的大语言模型合并
translated_abstract: 合并大语言模型（LLMs）是一种无需重新训练即可组合多个微调检查点能力的实用方法。然而，标准方案（线性权重平均、任务向量和Fisher加权平均）虽然能保持损失值，却可能在悄然破坏模型的对齐性。我们认为模型合并不是一种数值技巧，而是围绕已对齐锚点进行的几何约束操作：融合过程必须被引导以尊重安全几何结构，而不是事后才进行验证。我们提出了AlignMerge，一个几何感知的合并框架，它将对齐性作为显式不变量。在指令微调基础模型周围的局部Fisher图坐标系中，我们用投影矩阵P_A估计对齐子空间，并优化目标函数：L_AlignMerge = L_geo + lambda_align * L_align + lambda_bud * L_bud，其中L_geo使合并结果在Fisher-Rao几何中保持接近其专家模型，L_align惩罚沿对齐敏感方向的运动，L_bud强制执行软对齐约束。
tldr: 提出AlignMerge框架，通过Fisher引导的几何约束将对齐性作为大语言模型合并的显式不变量，防止标准合并方法在保持损失值的同时悄然破坏模型的安全对齐性。
en_tdlr: AlignMerge introduces a geometry-aware merging framework that treats alignment as an explicit invariant via Fisher-guided geometric constraints, preventing standard LLM merging methods from silently destroying alignment while preserving loss.
